title: Non-interventional study on different treatment modalities in first permanent molars affected by molar incisor hypomineralization (MIH)
summary: Recording the therapeutic success or survival of various dental interventions on first permanent molars with MIH over an observation period of three years

interventions.name: Pit and fissure sealing/ composite material
Pit and fissure sealing/ GIC material
Minimal-invasive coverage of enamel breakdowns/ composite material
Minimal-invasive coverage of enamel breakdowns/ GIC material

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
MIH-related dental intervention indicated on at least one first permanent molar
Exclusion criteria:
No MIH
